notes.title: Update 1/8/16
notes.content:
All Platforms:
- Title Screen sound fades in now
- You can use the Enter Key to select menu items
- Updated Special Thanks
- If you own the soundtrack you now also get access to it in FLAC format (If you don’t want to download the files you can uncheck it under DLC in your library)

Mac:
- Achievements now work (You won’t see a the pop up when you earn them since Steam Overlay is still broken)

Linux:
- Steam Overlay now works

Known Issues (Sorry!):
- Steam Overlay doesn’t work on Mac
- Steam Achievements don't work on Linux
- Steam Cloud doesn’t work cross-platform

Anyway, thanks for playing, everyone! It’s great to see that people are enjoying it. If you have a few minutes I’d be super grateful if you wrote a review, it'd go a long way in helping get the word out there!
